card.name: Linking words before radiation therapy
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs such as with, of, receiving, during, undergoing that come right before the words radiation or radiotherapy. Seen in drug-label text about combining a drug with radiation.

modes.label: Combined with radiation
modes.description: Preposition or adverb linking a drug or dosing to radiation therapy.
modes.example: Gemcitabine is not recommended for use in combination<< with>> radiation therapy.

modes.label: Patients receiving radiation
modes.description: Verb linking patients to radiation treatment in trial descriptions.
modes.example: primary squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck<< receiving>> radiation therapy randomized to darbepo

modes.label: Timing around radiation
modes.description: Word that sets when a drug is given relative to a radiation course.
modes.example: prior to initiating a course<< of>> radiation therapy.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward radiation-related terms and away from words like permanent.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before radiation therapy is named in a label.
